data.one_liner: Parses multipart and form-data requests for shelf handlers.
data.what_it_does: shelf_multipart provides extension types and methods for shelf handlers to easily check for and parse multipart and multipart/form-data requests. It allows iterating over parts, reading part headers, and reading data as streams, bytes, or strings.
use_when: You are building a backend using the shelf package
You need to handle file uploads or multipart form data in Dart
avoid_when: You are not using the shelf package for your server
You only need to handle standard JSON or URL-encoded bodies
strengths: Provides type safety around multipart checks using extension types
Easy iteration over request parts and form data parameters
Integrates seamlessly with the shelf ecosystem
weaknesses: Limited to the shelf package ecosystem
